text:
alex: Quick check — about to apply a small TF change to drop inference-api StatefulSet replicas 6 -> 4 in eu-west (non-peak). Want to confirm rollout strategy + PVC detach behavior before I hit apply. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/432
claire: Why reduce replicas? cost or a perf change? :thinking:
alex: Mostly cost and reducing churn from noisy nodes overnight. Also frees capacity for a batch job.
ravi: Sounds reasonable. Couple notes: ensure the STS uses podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady so ordinals are respected, and use rollingUpdate with partition=1 to avoid killing too many at once. Also increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 120 for safer drains.
jen: Also include a short preStop so connections drain: ```yaml
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sleep 20"]
```
claire: And secret wiring? I saw the TF plan touches secrets module — are we rotating KMS keys in the same apply?
alex: Yes the plan swaps kms_key_id in secrets/data module which triggers a replace of the secret version. Intent is staged apply: secrets module first, then the STS change.
infra-bot: Deploy check — current state: replicas=6, available=6, PVCs=6, PV reclaimPolicy=Retain, no active node drains found.
ravi: One more: the PR adds a mild pod anti-affinity tweak. To avoid cross-rack reshuffle add topologyKey: "kubernetes.io/hostname" so pods remain spread but don't bounce racks. Also add a PDB with minAvailable: 3 to protect availability during the scale down.
alex: Good call. I'll add PDB and tweak affinity. Do you want a quick canary before full apply? I can patch STS to 5 replicas in eu-west for a smoke test: `kubectl patch sts inference-api --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":5}]'`
claire: Do the canary only in eu-west and monitor latency + error rate in Console for 15m. If metrics look fine, proceed to 4. :thumbsup:
jen: lgtm — will approve PR once preStop, grace, and PDB are in. I'll stay on-call during the apply.
alex: Thanks all — updating PR now and will paste apply link + plan output when ready.
